result.title: FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet
result.summary: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead. FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\times$-$3.1\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU. On eight GPUs with context lengths up to 1M tokens, Dual CP achieves up to $4.8\times$ forward speedup and $4.4\times$ speedup for combined forward and backward execution over FLA KCP.

AI.brief_summary: FlashQLA 提出面向 Gated DeltaNet 的上下文并行执行框架，用 decay-aware 边界状态预处理、跨 GPU 的 Dual CP 摘要共享、负载自适应 Auto CP 与 kernel 协同设计，缓解 chunk 间顺序依赖，在单卡与八卡长上下文下取得明显加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 chunk 边界状态的压缩摘要与跨设备交换机制，可能为循环式 latent 推理状态的并行更新与跨块信息保持提供实现线索，值得核查这种摘要近似对状态保真度的影响。
